title: Prescriptive Scaling Laws for Data Constrained Training
abstract: arXiv:2605.01640v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Training compute is increasingly outpacing the availability of high-quality data. This shifts the central challenge from optimal compute allocation to extracting maximum value from limited data. The widely adopted Chinchilla scaling law assumes every training token is unique. This limits its ability to guide pretraining decisions in data-constrained regimes. We model the excess loss under repetition with a simple additive overfitting penalty and find that it accurately describes model behavior. Our scaling law yields qualitatively new compute-optimal allocation advice. Beyond a point, further repetition is counterproductive and compute is better spent on model capacity. We show that following our law's recommended configuration improves performance in data-constrained regimes. translated_title: 面向数据受限训练的规范性缩放定律
translated_abstract: 训练所需的计算量正日益超过高质量数据的可用量，这使得核心挑战从最优计算分配转变为如何从有限数据中提取最大价值。被广泛采用的 Chinchilla 缩放定律假设每个训练 token 都是唯一的，这限制了它在数据受限场景下指导预训练决策的能力。我们用一个简单的加性过拟合惩罚项对重复训练下的超额损失进行建模，发现它能准确描述模型行为。我们的缩放定律给出了性质上全新的计算最优分配建议：超过某个点后，进一步的重复训练会适得其反，此时计算资源最好用于提升模型容量。我们证明，遵循该定律推荐的配置可以改善数据受限场景下的模型性能。最后，由于我们的单参数形式将过拟合隔离在单个系数中，它使得不同训练配置之间能够进行直接比较。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种带加性过拟合惩罚项的规范性缩放定律，能准确刻画数据受限训练中重复数据的影响，并给出新的计算最优分配建议——当数据重复超过一定限度后，算力应投向扩大模型容量而非继续重复训练。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a prescriptive scaling law with a simple additive overfitting penalty that accurately captures the effect of data repetition in data-constrained training, yielding qualitatively new compute-optimal advice: beyond a point, compute is better spent on model capacity than on further repetition.
